stdout: Issue resolved in checked-out files. AnsibleDumper now registers represent_undefined for AnsibleUndefined, triggering the Jinja undefined error. to_yaml and to_nice_yaml wrap dump errors in named AnsibleFilterError with orig_exc. Templar converts filter errors whose cause is Jinja UndefinedError to AnsibleUndefinedVariable while preserving the original cause and fail_on_undefined behavior. Added regression coverage for direct dumping, both filters, supported values, and template rendering.
